# Cases that Source does not pass yet, one name per line. The list only gets
# shorter: remove a name when its case passes (design 11.2).

# The first list was generated once, from an empty list, with:
#
#   go test ./internal/format 2>&1 |
#     sed -n 's/^ *--- FAIL: TestSource\/cases\/\(.*\) (.*/\1/p' |
#     tr '_' '-' | sort
